description: The Baoji landslide research team publishes an inventory of large landslides in Baoji, Shaanxi Province, China. Visual interpretation of multi-date high-resolution imagery, supplemented with literature and hazard records, identified 3,422 landslides covering about 360.7 square kilometres. The published threshold targets features larger than 5,000 square metres. Zenodo supplies the named Shapefile archive under CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. Modellers can overlay these polygons with roads, buildings or river assets to assess exposure and calibrate regional susceptibility models. The size threshold excludes smaller failures, while image interpretation and uncertain event timing limit historical analysis. Geometry and event attribution were not independently tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: An Inventory of Large-Scale Landslides in Baoji City, Shaanxi Province, China
